summary:
Comprehensive Feature Gap Analysis and End-to-End Implementation Plan for GameZone, aligning exactly with the 8 uploaded reference screenshots:
1. Exact visual matching to screenshots (Dark violet/neon carnival palette, gold/orange accents, glowing towers).
2. Guild Clash two-team animated split scoreboard (Blue tower vs Orange tower, rising animations, AHEAD BY / BEHIND BY live difference counters, average & total score progression, user score breakdown).
3. Complete Game Lobby with authentic games (Fruit Samurai, Candy Match, Carrom, Memory Mania, Space Warrior, Knife Up, Bubble Shooter, Cricket).
4. Full Fantasy Captain & Vice-Captain flow (2x & 1.5x points).
5. Authentic 3-Tier Wallet and Transactions ledger with 30-day filter tabs (All, TDS, Add Cash/Withdrawal).
6. Non-monetary server-authoritative scoring & user architecture.
